purpose: Executable review contract for the fixed study; never supplied to either answerer as expected answers.

common_checks.original_scope: Original entity, population, historical date, source and requested outputs are preserved. Current survival/enrollment cannot silently narrow historical questions.
common_checks.quantities: Every reported quantity is reconciled at its declared source/grain/unit/definition. Missing values differ from zero; duplicated or omitted groups are explicit failures. Unscored quantities remain unassessed, not correct.
common_checks.source_fidelity: Native lineage and cited text/date/entity/relation match actual received inputs. Quotes exist verbatim, preserve subject/polarity/time and do not turn orders into use or authors into treating clinicians.
common_checks.coverage_and_unknowns: All requested populations/outputs and relevant source dispositions are accounted for. Supported absent inputs can pass engineering; unread required sources or missing wiring cannot be relabeled supported unknowns.
common_checks.no_overclaim: Observed facts, machine findings, hypotheses, scenarios, estimates and proposals are distinguished. No invented care, risk qualification, causal effect, hardship, realized savings or customer readiness.
common_checks.study_integrity: Source/code/protocol frozen; evaluator references and other-arm answers inaccessible; learning disabled. Every provider attempt/partial/error and unpriced cost is retained.

checks.historical_payer_binding: Use enrollment at each discharge. Retain unknown and multiple payers without duplicating discharges; disclose any alternative payer-allocation convention.
checks.year_change: Reconcile both calendar years, absolute change and percent with explicit zero/missing prior baselines.

checks.financial_lifecycles: Service-date cohort, allowed, signed adjudicated paid and separately received cash remain distinct with their clocks/currencies.
checks.cash_cohort_closure: All cash allocations reconcile to this service cohort, another known cohort or unlinked claims. Different coverage is not a receivable or missing payment.

checks.date_missingness: Reconcile all admission organizations and received/absent discharge dates; absent discharge never becomes zero duration.
checks.duration_definition: Explicitly identified recorded LOS or calendar date difference is checked against its own reference. Silent definition changes fail; invalid/missing clocks stay explicit.

Q03.execution: Preserve the existing paired ordinary pilot separately; no repeat paid Q03 campaign or pooling it as a frozen study run.

checks.clinical_family_scope: Declare the source-family universe and account for all selected current-version observations and omitted families.
checks.receipt_clock: Reported availability, event date and actual warehouse ingestion are different clocks. Unreceived/unknown clocks and superseded historical-state limitations remain explicit.

checks.cohort_and_fills: AF evidence and 2029 discharges use versioned evidence; dispensing is distinct from current use, and the full resolved patient cohort is represented.
checks.documented_reasons: Patient names and dated reasons/contradictions have exact source/subject/drug bindings; absent fill is not refusal or contraindication.

checks.copd_encounter_scope: COPD evidence and respiratory encounters have explicit source/date definitions and complete cohort accounting.
checks.medication_state: Intention, reported use, dispensing and explicit non-use are separate dated observations; disagreements produce specific evidence dependencies.

checks.referral_cohort: Received 2029 cardiology referrals and every resolved patient are accounted for without inventing destination or attendance.
checks.dated_roles: PCP assignment, referral destination, document author/addressee and actual attendance retain distinct dated source bindings; no inferred current cardiologist.

checks.request_stage_counts: Received requests, authorizations, schedules, recorded completions and preferences are distinct with source-bound counts and complete patient chains.
checks.unresolved_work: Each missing source relation remains a named evidence dependency suitable for internal review work; no care execution.

checks.definition_and_cutoff: Installed program specification versions and each historical cutoff are explicit. Absent historical inputs or uninstalled definitions remain concrete dependencies.
checks.program_boundaries: Candidate eligibility/overlap, payer entitlement and consent are separate; all required inputs and patient populations are represented.

checks.same_relation: Source-linked substance, subject, reaction and dates bind the allergy/interview relationship; same keyword is insufficient.
checks.interpretation_boundaries: Negated, uncertain, historical and copied accounts remain distinct; missing relation is named rather than asserted resolved.

checks.exposure_and_attribution: Historical attributed exposure, unknown practice, unmatched events, sample sizes and unadjusted rates reconcile without current-PCP substitution.
checks.case_mix: Adjusted comparison requires a justified model and measured input support. Missing inputs/qualification are named; no invented adjusted ranking.

checks.development: Declare payer-only full-history versus unified/provider scope, signed payments, service origin, development clock, duplicate/replacement policy and snapshot cutoff. Each alternative must independently reconcile.
checks.ultimate_limit: Observed development and incomplete runout remain separate from any modeled completion. Assumptions and source availability constrain ultimate estimates.

checks.active_account_definition: Define 2029 recorded activity versus economically open accounts. Account snapshots are stocks, not summed events; same patient/account/currency and event cutoffs are preserved.
checks.conservation: Integer-cent patient-balance and billed-allocation identities and received payment/refund flows reconcile; unresolved source links are retained.

checks.balance_cohort: Outstanding balance is from the received current account statement with explicit patient/account/currency binding.
checks.affordability_evidence: Financial amount alone cannot establish hardship/preferences. Any affordability statement has a same-subject dated documentary source; unknown is retained.

checks.appointment_grain: Every received appointment is counted once by scheduled month and actual appointment provider, including unknowns.
checks.status_versions: Installed version-resolved outcome governs completed/cancelled/no-show/scheduled distinctions, rather than interpreting raw booked status alone. Totals reconcile without causal claims.

checks.capacity_inputs: Observed demand and actual service-time/staffing availability are demonstrated. Missing inputs block numeric FTE/queue claims rather than receiving defaults.
checks.scenario_assumptions: The10% increase is a scenario; any queueing calculation states distribution, arrival/exposure, service time, staffing and utilization assumptions.

checks.monthly_exposure: All24months, eligible ED events, unmatched events, unknown/zero exposure and the simple stable-rate baseline reconcile.
checks.change_method: A registered method actually executes when supported; its assumptions, multiplicity, missing months and source-clock sensitivity are reported. No asserted true change point or cause from this arithmetic reference.

checks.index_and_followup: First recorded admission, index discharge, next event, contiguous eligibility and snapshot/death/end-of-coverage clocks are explicit; ambiguous chronology stays unresolved.
checks.survival_interpretation: Observed follow-up/censoring are not complete external-event capture or qualified modeled risk. Death/unknown eligibility and competing-event assumptions remain explicit.

checks.prediction_evidence: Report actual existing target and model receipts with positive-label support, time-safe input provenance, calibration and simple-baseline comparison.
checks.no_forced_fit: No new fit or risk claim. If no qualified predictor exists, the actual evidence dependency and existing failed/degenerate target results are retained.

checks.agenda_provenance: Utilization, care-gap and financial findings retain exact full-population denominators and original source/spec versions in one saved context.
checks.commercial_action: Observed facts, clinical nominations, explanations and contract-dependent opportunities are distinct with buyer/payer requirements and follow-up; no unsupported realizable savings.

checks.source_assertion: Each polarity/time/subject/copy-sensitive example links the original assertion, exact text/date/subject and the affected analytical conclusion.
checks.unassessed_scope: Unexamined source scope and unresolved contradictions are disclosed. Repeated copied statements are not independent corroboration.

checks.saved_parent_work: Actual saved Q08 findings and unresolved dependencies produce internal review requests with patient/source/context binding.
checks.localized_invalidation: A declared isolated source-version mutation invalidates dependent findings/work only; unchanged patients and prior versions remain inspectable.

checks.spec_adapter_replay: Actual saved Q09 context is replayed under declared isolated spec/adapter versions; changed nominations and exact inputs are inspected.
checks.rollback_and_staleness: Stale reuse/model artifacts are rejected and known-good definitions recover. Existing failed model qualifications remain failed.

checks.faithful_deliverable: Actual Q20 saved analysis produces readable HTML with received names, clinical context, dated roles, program reasoning, documented exceptions, financial assumptions and linked sources.
checks.render_and_review: Rendered artifact is visually inspected; unresolved requirements and proposed actions survive generation. No technical companion or routine PDF is required.

checks.portable_core: An explicitly authored invoice/payment fixture exercises the existing generic entity/date/domain quantities, money lifecycle, percentages, missingness and dependency invalidation.
checks.portable_recovery: Wrong entity/domain/date and stale values fail; known-good source/spec recover. This is a core contract demonstration, not a commercial connector claim.

decision_rule: Every required engineering check must have a supported passed disposition and evidence; any failed or unassessed check prevents complete engineering acceptance for that case. Clinical/model qualification is separate and remains unqualified without its independent evidence. Do not collapse quantities, coverage, source errors, verification uncertainty, latency and cost into one success score.
numeric_policy: Native references define received-source calculations, not exclusive answer formats. A reviewer may map actual output fields/units into a reference with recorded transforms and exact output paths. Values are never rewritten. A genuinely different declared measure needs a separate independently prepared reference; report it unassessed until then.
